notes.title: PvE Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40518512/0432087f1f36225c1cde73bd70a1e5ab61bb6ff5.png[/img]


- Added PvE gamemode (Survive as long as you can with endless bots trying to kill you)
- Fortress and Buried maps have been reworked (The old maps can still be played if the host types 'cheat:oldmaps' in the lobby chat in PvP)
- Added a Stats section to keep track of Kills, Deaths, Games played, etc.
- Added new movement mechanics (Ground Glide, Wall Climb, and improved Sprinting)
- Added a new and improved Tutorial (It will launch the first time you play GunKour)
- Various Bug fixes and small changes

Please be sure to report any bugs you find in the GunKour Community Hub.
